rules: canonical Standard; no Pie/Swap; no threefold/repetition adjudication

interpretation.rawHeadToHead: Not a useful algorithm-strength discriminator because the seat/opening effect dominates the result.
interpretation.seatFinding: No P1 engine won any of the 100 games; P0 won 96 and 4 games were natural 35-35 draws.
interpretation.balanceFinding: Under the tested strong-AI budget, unrestricted Standard is extremely P0-favored empirically.
interpretation.relationshipToForcedOpeningTests: Does not contradict earlier B3:CW/B3:CCW resource-fair tests where UCT-PB beat Trạng Nguyên 16-0; those tests suppress the dominant unrestricted-opening seat confound.
interpretation.claimLimit: Empirical benchmark evidence only; not a game-theoretic proof or solved result. No live Trạng Nguyên learning snapshot was included.
